caption: The upgrade path to Extra: pass Element 4 (50 questions, 37 correct to pass, Elements 2 and 3 already credited); at the session the Form 605 is properly submitted to the administering VEs and the CSCE is in your hand — and from that moment you may use Extra privileges immediately under §97.9(b), signing /AE on every transmission (§97.119(f)(3)). When the ULS record shows Amateur Extra — typically within days — you drop the suffix; privileges then rest on the license itself and you keep your call sign. The interim authority ends at final disposition of the application or 365 days after passing, whichever comes first.
spoken: five boxes — pass Element 4; CSCE plus Form 605; on the air at once signing slash A E; ULS shows Amateur Extra; drop the A E
